subject: CYCLE-1 FINDING: P0 inner-wake causal gap revalidated unchanged on current 7127c287
body: Rescoped Research independently revalidated Primary's Cycle-1 source audit against actual current main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64 after the protocol-hardening commit. All nine runtime blobs used by the audit are byte-identical to the a95cc839 audit blobs, so the P0 conclusion is still current: WakeInner proves a generation-fenced physical wake request/result but the same opening attempt is not carried through logical-display readiness, first vsync/frame plan, SurfaceControl transaction/presentation, FIRST_USEFUL and FIRST_INTERACTIVE. TransitionEvent/TransitionLab already expose sparse typed fields including generation, serviceEpoch and presentationAttemptSequence, but recordFrame/recordTransaction do not attach an opening-attempt identity. Cycle-2 will falsify the smallest observation-only correlation design. No production writes.

service.last_test_result: 9/9 audited runtime blob identities unchanged at current HEAD
